intro: Jude is a short, urgent letter by Jude, a brother of James, and by tradition, of Jesus.
It warns against false teachers, and calls believers to contend for the faith, and to keep themselves in the love of God.
Listen for its beautiful closing blessing: now unto him that is able to keep you from falling.

card.key: Contend for the faith (1:3) · Able to keep you from falling (1:24)

next_say: the book of Revelation, the last book of the Bible
